name: io.github.IBM/data-intelligence-mcp-server
title: IBM Data Intelligence
description: MCP Server implementation for IBM Data Intelligence

environmentVariables.name: DI_SERVICE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Data Intelligence service URL (cluster URL for CPD)

environmentVariables.name: DI_APIKEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for authentication (alternative to DI_AUTH_TOKEN)

environmentVariables.name: DI_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Username, required for CPD when using DI_APIKEY

environmentVariables.name: DI_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for authentication (alternative to DI_APIKEY)

environmentVariables.name: LOG_FILE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Log file path; required in stdio mode since stdout carries the MCP protocol
